patch_description:
This crossover returns a refined ansatz that blends the stronger motif-aware design from the best prior program with the stable training/utility scaffolding of the current program. Key choices:

- Use symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations (corners, edges, center) to improve parameter efficiency and inductive bias.
- Include shared CRZ couplings around the outer ring and separate center-edge CRZ couplings, giving expressible but compact entanglement.
- Add ZZZ multi-qubit rotations aligned to the eight winning lines, grouped by geometric orientation (rows/cols/diagonals) to enable motif discovery aligned with the task.
- Split CCRZ center-conditioned triples by geometry (edge-edge-center vs corner-corner-center) to allow different center-conditioning behaviors.
- Restore separate post-RZ phase parameters per symmetry group (corner/edge/center) for flexibility without exploding parameter count.

This ANSATZ_SPEC matches the high-performing motif-discovery variant from prior experiments (keeps N_PARAMS_per_block = 13), and is dropped into the unchanged training/evaluation framework for consistent comparison.
